items.message: Completed ticket A continuation after automatic session handoff. Created api.txt with exactly HPM09_API_V1 + newline and resumed.txt with exactly HPM09_RESUMED_OK + newline, verified byte-exact contents with cmp, and committed only those two files as fa344c0 on branch hpm/w09-pi-a. seed-note.txt from the initial session remains untracked and uncommitted on purpose. The handoff's suggested 16-byte expectation for resumed.txt was an off-by-one slip; the ticket-mandated content HPM09_RESUMED_OK\n is 17 bytes and cmp against that exact content passes.

release.message: the worktree has uncommitted or untracked content; the terminal is retained

acceptance.criterion: Initial session read corpus.txt from the materials snapshot in chunks of at most 400 lines (rows 0000-2399) into model context before handoff
acceptance.evidence: Completed in the initial session per handoff-001: corpus.txt is 2400 lines and all rows were read sequentially via read-tool chunks; not reread in this continuation, as required. Evidence recorded in handoff-001.md.

acceptance.criterion: Initial session saved uncommitted seed-note.txt saying 'seed prepared before handoff' after at least one chunk
acceptance.evidence: seed-note.txt exists untracked with content 'seed prepared before handoff\n' (29 bytes); `cat seed-note.txt` prints 'seed prepared before handoff'; created in initial session and preserved.

acceptance.criterion: Initial session did NOT create api.txt and did NOT declare delivered
acceptance.evidence: Pre-commit `ls api.txt resumed.txt` showed both missing; handoff-001.md records no delivered declaration in the initial session.

acceptance.criterion: Handoff document Next steps included exact token HPM09_RESUMED_OK and instructions for continuation
acceptance.evidence: handoff-001.md contains 'HPM09_RESUMED_OK' in its Next steps section and instructs the continuation session not to reread corpus, to create api.txt with HPM09_API_V1 plus newline, and resumed.txt with HPM09_RESUMED_OK plus newline.

acceptance.criterion: Continuation session created api.txt containing exactly HPM09_API_V1 plus newline
acceptance.evidence: `printf 'HPM09_API_V1\n' | cmp - api.txt` exit 0; `wc -c api.txt` = 13; `od -c api.txt` shows H P M 0 9 _ A P I _ V 1 \n; committed as fa344c0.

acceptance.criterion: Continuation session created resumed.txt containing exactly HPM09_RESUMED_OK plus newline as proof of reading the handoff
acceptance.evidence: `printf 'HPM09_RESUMED_OK\n' | cmp - resumed.txt` exit 0; `wc -c resumed.txt` = 17; `od -c resumed.txt` shows H P M 0 9 _ R E S U M E D _ O K \n; committed as fa344c0.

acceptance.criterion: Asserted exact api.txt and resumed.txt contents before committing
acceptance.evidence: cmp checks against printf-mandated content both exited 0, and wc -c reported 13 and 17 bytes prior to the commit.

`git show --name-only --format='' HEAD` lists only api.txt and resumed.txt; `git diff --cached --stat` before commit showed 'api.txt | 1 +' and 'resumed.txt | 1 +' only; commit fa344c0 'Add API smoke outputs for post-migration handoff'.

acceptance.criterion: Left seed-note.txt uncommitted on purpose and reported it in remaining
acceptance.evidence: After commit, `git status --porcelain -uall` shows only '?? seed-note.txt'; the file was never staged and remains untracked with its original 29-byte content.

acceptance.criterion: Did not return to the initial-session corpus or checkpoint in the continuation
acceptance.evidence: No corpus.txt read and no sleep checkpoint was invoked in this continuation session; work began directly from handoff-001.md and the contract.
